fixes.result: Approved scoped details RPC supplies real pickup name/address and authoritative coordinates; buttons open the correct pickup or destination on Google Maps, use real address if coordinates unavailable, and hide when both absent. Native errors show owned safe text. Failed details query causes retry/error, never fake location.
fixes.backendVerification: Separate backend reviewer actual SQL tests cover other identities, reassignment, expiry, revoked roster and order coordinate precedence.

fixes.result: GPS status stores a stable enum and resolves current CMS locale at render. Assignment enum is translated. OS watcher errors are shown safely; successful real update clears a prior failure. Background batches use newest valid fresh real fix instead of an invalid future sample.

Old availability heartbeat cannot write the replacement account. Pending order/detail/GPS reads are scoped to the account, and a prior courier marker hides immediately when identity changes. Map actions reject stale-account callbacks.

Boolean/array/object/blank coordinate coercion rejected. Missing road geometry shows actual known locations only. Actual segments preserved; no dashed line advertised as road route. Pickup viewport follows current real coordinates. Courier signal expiry during a hung refresh hides the marker and accurately reports stale GPS. Marker time uses selected Goodies locale formatter.

All accept/decline/pickup/delivered variants use actual RPC argument paths, synchronously prevent duplicates, refresh only on success and show safe uncertain-response errors. Sign-out waits for actual session logout, blocks active deliveries and catches asynchronous failure. Parent App bridge error propagation repaired by vendor agent.
